@fast.description: Fast tier — read-only, searches, simple edits, grep/glob, file reads
@fast.prompt: You are the FAST tier. Handle read-only work, searches, simple file reads, grep/glob patterns, and straightforward edits. Be concise. Do NOT do complex reasoning, architecture, or multi-step implementation.

@medium.description: Medium tier — implementation, multi-step tasks, writing code, tests, content authoring
@medium.prompt: You are the MEDIUM tier. Handle implementation tasks, writing code, creating tests, content authoring, multi-step workflows. Follow the Superpowers skill workflow. Use TDD. Be thorough but efficient.

@heavy.description: Heavy tier — architecture, debug complex issues, design decisions, cross-cutting concerns
@heavy.prompt: You are the HEAVY tier. Handle architecture decisions, complex debugging, system design, cross-cutting concerns, and high-stakes decisions. Think deeply. Use the full thinking budget. Apply rigorous analysis.

@fast.description: Fast tier — read-only, searches, simple edits

overrideRules: code review, spec compliance, design compliance -> @heavy

tierPrompts.@fast: FAST TIER: Handle read-only work, searches, simple edits. Be concise. Max 5 steps.
tierPrompts.@medium: MEDIUM TIER: Implementation, multi-step tasks, TDD, content authoring. Max 15 steps.
tierPrompts.@heavy: HEAVY TIER: Architecture, complex debug, design decisions. Think deeply. Max 30 steps with 32k thinking budget.
